__inputs.name: DS_AZURE_MONITOR
__inputs.label: Azure Monitor
__inputs.description: Datasource Azure Monitor con acceso de lectura a Application Insights.

title: AI Tokens - Consumo unificado
description: Consumo de tokens A2A/APIM desde customMetrics de Application Insights.

list.name: service
list.label: Servicio APIM

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Total Tokens")
| extend
    service = tostring(customDimensions["Service ID"]),
    agent = tostring(customDimensions["agent"]),
    department = tostring(customDimensions["department"]),
    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    Tokens = todouble(valueSum)
| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    department = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", department)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", department)),
    team = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", team)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", team)),
    user = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", user)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", user))
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| distinct service
| order by service asc

options.content: **Consumo de tokens, no costes ni peticiones.** Total = `Total Tokens`; entrada/salida se muestran por separado. Filtros comunes a todas las secciones. Comprueba frescura y calidad antes de interpretar un cero como ausencia de consumo.

panels.title: Salida / total
panels.description: Proporcion de tokens de salida; no es proporcion del coste. Sin total, sin porcentaje.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Total Tokens")
| extend
    service = tostring(customDimensions["Service ID"]),
    agent = tostring(customDimensions["agent"]),
    department = tostring(customDimensions["department"]),
    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    Tokens = todouble(valueSum)
| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    department = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", department)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", department)),
    team = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", team)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", team)),
    user = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", user)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", user))
| where $__contains(service, $service)
| where $__contains(agent, $agent)
| where $__contains(department, $department)
| where $__contains(team, $team)
| where $__contains(user, $user)
| summarize Total = sumif(Tokens, name == "Total Tokens"), Salida = sumif(Tokens, name == "Completion Tokens")
| project Porcentaje = iff(Total > 0, 100.0 * Salida / Total, real(null))

panels.title: Evolucion de entrada y salida
panels.description: Tokens por intervalo, no una tasa por segundo. Total Tokens no se agrega como tercera serie para evitar doble contabilizacion.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Total Tokens")
| extend
    service = tostring(customDimensions["Service ID"]),
    agent = tostring(customDimensions["agent"]),
    department = tostring(customDimensions["department"]),
    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    Tokens = todouble(valueSum)
| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    department = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", department)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", department)),
    team = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", team)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", team)),
    user = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", user)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", user))
| where $__contains(service, $service)
| where $__contains(agent, $agent)
| where $__contains(department, $department)
| where $__contains(team, $team)
| where $__contains(user, $user)
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens")
| summarize Tokens = sum(Tokens) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), name
| order by timestamp asc
